Are you a natural communicator who enjoys solving problems and making customers feel heard? Do you speak fluent English and Spanish? Then this Customer Service Representative role in the life sciences sector may be your next step.

As Customer Service Representative, you are the first point of contact for customers and the link between them and the teams working behind the scenes. You listen, work out what is needed, and make sure it gets sorted quickly and properly.

What you will do

• Handle customer questions by phone and in writing: orders, billing, cancellations, account queries, complaints and errors

• Welcome customers warmly, understand their issue and either resolve it yourself or route it to the right colleague

• Take in and process orders, and arrange refunds and exchanges where needed

• Create and maintain customer accounts with accurate, up-to-date information

• Support shipping and transport documentation and answer related questions

• Log and follow up on service requests

• Help coordinate product recalls when they occur

• Spot customer needs and share ideas for relevant products or services with management

• Work closely with the commercial team, logistics, Finance, Quality, Regulatory and Legal

As a Customer Service Representative you should have the following characteristics:

• A bachelor’s degree in languages or economics, or equivalent knowledge gained through experience or training

• At least 3 years of experience in a comparable customer service or order management role within an international sales organisation. Experience in medical devices or life sciences is a clear advantage

• Fluent English and Spanish, spoken and written. Dutch or other European languages are a plus

• Solid knowledge of the order process, and hands-on experience with an ERP system (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics AX)

• Good command of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Strong telephone skills and a real talent for listening

• An analytical and organised way of working, with careful documentation

• The ability to juggle several tasks, stay calm in a fast-changing environment and handle conflicts constructively

• Good interpersonal skills and the confidence to make an impact

Nice to haves

• Experience with Salesforce CRM

• Knowledge of how to use artificial intelligence in your daily work

We are seeking an experienced forklift operator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for the efficient and safe movement of goods within our warehouse. You have a keen eye for detail and strive for perfection in every task you undertake.

• Expertly operate and maneuver the forklift for loading, unloading, and relocating goods.

• Accurately inspect and record incoming and outgoing shipments.

• Maintain an organized and orderly workspace by placing goods in their designated locations.

• Conduct daily maintenance checks on the forklift and report any issues or damages.

• Actively contribute to the compliance with safety and health regulations in the workplace.

• Willingness to do fysical work.

If you are looking for a job in the harbour in a logistic envoirement, have no doubt and apply for this function!

• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a forklift operator.

• Thorough knowledge of forklift operations.

• Excellent understanding of safety and health regulations.

• Physically fit and capable of working in shifts.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Team player with effective communication skills in Dutch or English

Zij zijn een innovatieve en groeiende speler in de verse voedingssector, waar kwaliteit, duurzaamheid en teamwork centraal staan. In een dynamische omgeving krijg je de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Samen bouwen ze elke dag aan sterke resultaten én een succesvolle toekomst.

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Shift Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily operations of a modern packaging and production department. You lead a team of approximately 150 employees across multiple packaging lines and ensure that production targets, quality standards and customer requirements are achieved efficiently and safely.

You are a visible leader on the shop floor, coaching and supporting your team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and performance.

What will you do?

• Lead and support a large operational team, including direct supervision of team leaders.
• Monitor production planning, quality, safety and productivity targets.
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics and maintenance teams to ensure smooth daily operations.
• Follow up on employee performance, coaching and development.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
• Ensure products meet the highest quality standards and customer expectations.

Who are you?

• You have experience in a supervisory role within a production, packaging or food manufacturing environment.
• You are a strong people manager who can motivate, coach and develop teams.
• You remain calm under pressure and can effectively prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• You have an interest in production processes and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English; knowledge of Romanian is an asset.
• You are quality-focused, hands-on and solution-oriented.
• You understand the flexibility required in a fresh food environment where quality and customer service are key.

Do you have hands-on production planning experience and practical knowledge of ERP and Excel? Join us as a Production Planner. Apply today!As a production planner, you coordinate the planning process from the arrival of machines and parts through assembly, technical checks and final delivery to the customer. 
• You plan and coordinate the process from incoming machines and parts to final delivery. 
• You ensure that parts, assembly activities and technical checks are scheduled correctly. 
• You monitor progress and adjust the production schedule when needed. 
• You coordinate closely with Supply Chain Management, the technical team and Sales. 
• You identify bottlenecks and help optimize production flow and capacity. 
• You accurately register incoming equipment and related information in the system.
What are we looking for in you? 
• You have relevant experience in production planning or a similar role. 
• You have hands-on experience with SAP or another ERP system. Theoretical knowledge alone is not sufficient. 
• You are proficient in MS Office, particularly Excel. 
• You have sufficient English skills for daily communication with colleagues and other departments.

Jobomschrijving

What does the role involve?

• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.
• You precisely measure materials.
• You perform calculations and ensure everything runs according to plan.
• You work in an environment where quality and precision are key.

Profile – What do we expect from you?

• Strong numerical skills and the ability to measure accurately.
• Good spatial awareness.
• Fluency in Dutch or very good proficiency in English.
• Flexibility: you work in day shifts, but are willing to switch to a two-shift system during peak workload.
• Careful and correct working method, with strong attention to detail.

Do you love turning a phone call into a lasting customer relationship? As an Inside Sales Account Manager in Tienen, you win over Polish customers and help their business grow. Apply for this job today!
 

You mix hunting for new customers with looking after existing accounts. Your tasks as an Inside Sales Account Manager will be: 
 

 
• You onboard Polish customers and win back inactive accounts.
 
• You recruit new traders and dealers from incoming calls or from a database.
 
• You nurture the relationships in your portfolio so their business grows togheter with the company. Once a year, you visit a selected group of customers with a commercial manager.
 
• You present and demo our sales solutions to buyers and sellers, and run call campaigns to launch new solutions, products and services.
 
• You follow up and report on market trends and performance in your territory, to boost sales and grow the company's market share. 

Does this sound like you?
 

 
• You speak English and Polish fluently. Another language is a plus.
 
• You have 1 to 5 years of experience in inside sales or a similar commercial role.
 
• You have strong sales and negotiation skills, and you love the exitment of closing deals.
 
• You explain your ideas clearly, in speech and in writing, and you feel comfortable selling by phone.
 
• You work towards sales targets and aim to beat them. You stay positive under pressure and keep learning.

Are you a skilled driver who keeps a warehouse running without a hitch? For a logistics company in Geel, we are looking for a Forklift & Reach Truck Driver (2 shifts) who enjoys variety, pace, and accurate work. In this role, you steer smoothly through the aisles to place pallets in the right spots and lend a hand on the warehouse floor.
 

 
 

Ready for a secure job with great pay? Read on!
 

 
 

Interested? Apply using the button, call 011 54 92 85, or send a message with your CV to talentcenter4@randstad.be.
 

VG 458/BUOSAP
 

 

We are looking for the following profile:
 
 

• You hold valid licenses for both forklift and reach truck. Plenty of experience but missing the actual paper? We are glad to look at training options to get you certified! 

• You easily speak and understand Dutch or English. Clear communication is essential for safety rules and staying in sync with your crew. 

• You like variety in your day (balancing vehicle work with floor tasks) and are ready to pitch in on a night or weekend shift during busy peak periods like the holidays. 

• You have your own reliable ride to commute to our site in Geel.  

 
 

Your daily routine:
 
 

• Operating your forklift or reach truck, you smoothly place pallets into high rack storage and keep stock levels topped up. 

• You won't just be behind the wheel all day. You frequently step out of the cabin to pick orders using a barcode scanner. 

• Manually moving, stacking, and unloading boxes is no issue for you. You are physically active, reliable, and ready to roll up your sleeves.

Do you want to work as a warehouse worker at Kuehne+Nagel in Geel either in 2 shifts, or on a fixed early or late shift for a great hourly wage of €15.65 gross? This is your chance! For a temporary 2-week assignment during the busy Sinterklaas and Christmas period, you will play an indispensable role in getting all parcels ready for shipment on time.
 

 
 

Do you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and making sure everything goes out the door smoothly? Then this is the job for you! You will step into a varied and active role where time flies and your effort truly counts. 
 

 
 

Interested? Send your CV straight away to talentcenter1@randstad.be, apply via the 'apply' button, or call us on 011 54 92 85!
 

 
 

VG 458/BUOSAP
 

 

 

• Good command of Dutch or English. 

• Willing to work in 2 shifts (if you are only available for the early or late shift, this is definitely an option too). 

• You are available for two weeks starting from 23/11. 

• Availability on Saturday or Sunday is a plus, not a must. 

• In possession of your own transport (car, bicycle...) to easily reach Kuehne+Nagel in Geel.  

 
 
 

• Accurately sorting and neatly packing products to high quality standards. 

• Applying the correct shipping labels and stickers to boxes. 

• Strapping pallets (securing them with sturdy bands) for safe transport. 

• Physically lifting and restacking boxes (up to approx. 20 kg max.).

package frozen food products for leading food companies according to the highest quality and food safety standards. To support our growth, we are looking for an experienced Packaging Operator to work in a fixed shift.

Your Responsibilities

Do you enjoy coaching a team, solving customer issues and improving how things work?
 

For an international B2B company in 
Zaventem, MetiSelect is looking for a 
Customer Service Team Leader.
 

You will lead a team of 
four to five Customer Care colleagues and work closely with the Regional Business Manager. Alongside the daily team coordination, you will follow up on commercial agreements, prepare reports and help improve the service provided to customers and business partners.
 

You make sure your team knows what needs to happen, has the support to do it and follows customer requests through to completion.
 

Your responsibilities include the following.
 
 

•  

Lead and coach your team. Organise the workload, coordinate leave, support new colleagues and follow up on individual and team performance.
  

•  

Help resolve complex customer issues. Work with Sales, Finance and Supply Chain to find solutions and keep customers informed.
  

•  

Manage an existing partner relationship. Be the main operational contact for one business partner in Turkey, discussing open requests and coordinating follow-up internally.
  

•  

Follow up on commercial agreements. Keep track of pricing updates, contract deadlines, renewals and agreed discounts, working with the relevant colleagues in Sales, Finance and Legal.
  

•  

Use data to improve service. Prepare reports and maintain dashboards to monitor response times, open requests and commercial results.
  

•  

Improve processes. Investigate recurring problems and work with colleagues, including IT, to make workflows clearer and more efficient.
  

•  

Support the use of Salesforce. Help maintain accurate customer information and, as you become familiar with the system, support colleagues with questions and consistent ways of working.
  
 

•  

You have experience in 
B2B customer service, sales support, order management or commercial operations. You enjoy helping people develop while staying involved in the daily work.
  

•  

You bring 
at least five years of relevant experience, including experience directly managing a team.
  

•  

You have coached colleagues, set priorities and followed up on their performance.
  

•  

You understand how customer requests, commercial agreements and internal processes connect.
  

•  

You are comfortable using 
Excel, reports and KPIs to identify problems and decide what needs attention.
  

•  

You have worked with an 
ERP system, such as SAP or Dynamics. 
Salesforce experience is a strong advantage. Training can be considered if your wider experience fits the role.
  

•  

You communicate confidently in 
professional English. German or Italian is a plus.
  

•  

You take initiative, keep track of commitments and involve the right people to get things resolved.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Start as an experienced order picker on the permanent night shift at Kuehne+Nagel in Tessenderlo!

As an experienced order picker on the permanent night shift, you will join the team handling the exclusive toy department at Kuehne+Nagel in Tessenderlo. During the night shift, you will oversee the accurate processing, quality control and preparation for shipment of outgoing goods. Thanks to your logistics experience, night-time operations run smoothly, ensuring every order is ready for transport on time.

Our AI agent will contact you via WhatsApp to ask a few questions and verify that you meet the job's minimum requirements. A consultant will always review your application and determine the next steps. If you have questions about this screening process, please contact us by applying for this vacancy or by reaching out to your nearest Randstad office.

Ready to start a long-term role? Call 011 54 92 85 or email talentcenter1@randstad.be!

VG 458/BUOSAP

• You have at least 6 months of experience as an order picker in a warehouse or distribution environment.
• You have a good command of Dutch or English to correctly follow safety and work instructions.
• You are physically fit, energetic, and looking for a long-term position on a permanent night shift.
• You have access to your own transport to reach the site in Tessenderlo independently (public transport is not an option).

Your responsibilities as an order picker:

• Picking orders using a handheld scanner or voice-picking system.
• Thoroughly checking product codes, quantities, and packaging quality.
• Carefully packing and preparing goods for shipment in accordance with strict guidelines.
• Monitoring stock levels and immediately reporting any discrepancies.
• Operating internal transport equipment (such as an electric pallet truck) and maintaining a safe, orderly work environment.
